[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42550418/b9d60c07b383c45baba068eddd3b15f3b3632570.png[/img]

notes.title: New Mechanic Preview and Many Fixes
notes.notes:
[h3][b]★ New Mechanic ★[/b][/h3]
We are testing some new design about [b]More Slot[/b], [b]More Cost[/b], and [b]Overload Mechanic[/b]!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42550418/385cae48ccb60e021b428826c049b501243c459f.png[/img]

[h3][b]★ Fixes ★[/b][/h3]
==== Fixes ====
● Fixed an issue where some brand of controllers would suddenly disconnect during the game.
● Fixed an issue where the game would become slightly unresponsive every few seconds.
● Fixed an issue where some devices were unable to view cutscene animations.
● Fixed some dialogue choices not appearing.
● Fixed some issues with the transparency of the curtains in cutscene animations.
● Fixed the UI displaying the wrong lines during certain cutscene animations.

● Fixed an issue with the Rose Idol DLC where Koishi's animation would sometimes bug out during her performance in the lounge.
● Fixed an issue with the Rose Idol DLC where the wrong music would be placed in the lounge.
● Fixed an issue with the Rose Idol DLC where Wisebit would appear in the Deserted Train's lounge.

● Fixed an issue in Hero Mode where interacting with certain amenities would crash the game.
● Fixed an issue in Hero Mode where combat hazards would disappear because of the player returning to the main menu.
● Fixed an issue in Hero Mode where immediately exiting out after accepting the Ice Shaver trade would not give out any gold.
● Fixed the Esper Cape being unable to dispel the Hero Mode secret boss's bullets.
● Fixed an issue where Doremy wouldn't be able to use her spell card during her last phase in Hero Mode.

==== Improvements ====
● Fixed the game loading for too long. The game should load a lot faster now.
● Fixed Koishi's icon being too big in the load save screen.
● Improved some UI navigation logic to avoid confusion after getting used to the layout.

==== Adjustments ====
● Slightly decreased Frozen Rose's duration; slightly increased the damage dealt when an enemy collides with the flowers.
● Slightly decreased the score required to top the leaderboard in Kappa Rocket.
● In Hero Mode, the Frenzy effect for Frozen Rose has been changed to a chance to regain uses.
